episodes.title: The Disappearance of Gabby Petito
episodes.description: In the summer of 2021, Gabby Petito and her fiancé Brian Laundrie set out on a four-month van trip across the United States, documenting it on YouTube and Instagram. Brian returned to his parents' home in Florida without her and refused to speak to anyone about where she was. This episode walks through their timeline, the Moab body-cam footage, and how the case changed the way police handle domestic disturbance calls.

episodes.title: Hunting the Golden State Killer
episodes.description:
For more than forty years, California was haunted by an elusive predator known across decades by different names: the Visalia Ransacker, the East Area Rapist, the Original Night Stalker, and ultimately, the Golden State Killer. Leaving behind dozens of violated homes, traumatized survivors, and shattered families, the attacker seemed to vanish into thin air by the mid-1980s, evading traditional police work and fingerprint databases alike.

In this episode, I walk you through how a predator who once wore a police badge managed to operate in the shadows, and how investigators revolutionized criminal forensics by using genetic genealogy to crack open the coldest trail in California history. We examine the timeline, the evidence, and the long road to unmasking an ordinary retiree living in a quiet suburban neighborhood.

episodes.title: The Interrogation of Chris Watts
episodes.description: The forty-eight hours in which Chris Watts's story came apart on camera, from the welfare check on August 13, 2018 to the oil site at 11 that night two days later. A friend who would not leave a doorstep, a patrol officer who noticed a husband was too calm, a neighbor's security camera, an FBI agent who held back his best evidence, a polygraph score of negative 18, and the way out that investigators offered him. Then the plea, the sentence, and the versions of the story he has told since; where the published accounts disagree, the episode says so.

episodes.title: Murders in Moscow: The Plea
episodes.description: What happened in the Moscow, Idaho case after the arrest of Bryan Kohberger. The episode covers the pre-trial motions, the battles over DNA and cell-site evidence, and the plea agreement in the summer of 2025. It follows the earlier episode about Ethan, Madison, Xana and Kaylee, which is the place to start.

episodes.title: The Menendez Brothers: The Parole Years
episodes.description: What happened to Lyle and Erik Menendez after the verdict: thirty years of appeals that went nowhere, the marriages inside prison walls, the TikTok generation that heard the abuse testimony differently, a letter found in a dresser, and a former Menudo member who came forward in 2023. Then the part that is still moving: one district attorney who asked for resentencing and another who called their defense self-serving lies, the May 2025 ruling that cut their sentences to fifty years to life, the parole board that said no three months later, the judge who refused a new trial, and the early parole hearing now set for March 2027. The murders and the trials are covered in an earlier episode, so this one tells 1989 once and spends its time on everything since.

episodes.title: Delphi: The Appeal
episodes.description: Three judges, one question. On September 21, 2026, the Indiana Court of Appeals heard Richard Allen's challenge to his conviction for the murders of Abby Williams and Libby German. As of early October 2026, it has not ruled. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: everything that has happened in the Delphi case since my 2022 episode. The misfiled tip, the arrest, the confessions from a prison cell, the trial, the 130-year sentence, and the three questions in front of the appeals court, with the state's answer to each. He is convicted and he is appealing. Both of those are true.

episodes.title: Gilgo Beach: Eight Names
episodes.description: In April 2026, Rex Heuermann was asked how he killed eight women. He gave the same one-word answer each time. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the Gilgo Beach murders from the 911 call that started the search to the guilty plea that ended it. Who the women were, why the case stalled for a decade, the truck and the pizza crust that broke it, and what is still unanswered: Shannan Gilbert, the victim known as Asian Doe, and a mother and daughter whose case turned out to be something else.

episodes.title: The Miami Apartment Stabbing
episodes.description: Courtney Clenney was arrested on August 10, 2022. She pleaded guilty on August 10, 2026. Four years, to the day, and the case still did not answer its own question. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the killing of Christian Obumseli in a Miami high-rise. The fourteen minutes on April 3, 2022, the elevator video, the medical examiner's finding that broke the self-defense account, the four months before an arrest, the battered spouse defense that never reached a jury, and what a plea leaves unsettled. If any of this sounds like your life, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233.

episodes.title: JonBenet Ramsey: Thirty Years
episodes.description: Thirty years on, two investigations are still running: Boulder police, and a volunteer team working from the spreadsheet a dead detective left behind. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: what the record in the JonBenet Ramsey case actually shows at thirty years. The morning the scene was lost, the ransom note two courts read two ways, the grand jury vote that stayed secret for fourteen years, the unknown male DNA, and where both investigations stand now. No one has ever been charged.

episodes.title: Elisa Lam and the Cecil Hotel
episodes.description: Elisa Lam was a Canadian student traveling alone through California when she vanished from a Los Angeles hotel. The only clue left behind was a security video from an elevator, which left millions of people guessing when the case took over the internet in 2013. The episode follows her journey down the coast, her struggles with mental health, her final known movements in downtown LA, and a hotel search restricted by legal limits. It ends with the discovery on the roof, the coroner's final conclusions, and how online sleuths built a mystery around the case.

episodes.title: The Murdaugh Family Murders
episodes.description: On a June night in 2021, Maggie and Paul Murdaugh were found dead near the dog kennels of the family's hunting lodge in the South Carolina Lowcountry. Alex Murdaugh told investigators he had been napping at the house and then left to visit his mother, but a video Paul recorded at the kennels, with Alex's voice in the background, told a different story. The episode walks through the timeline, the botched crime scene, the 2023 trial, and the 2026 ruling that threw out the murder convictions; Alex Murdaugh is awaiting a new trial, set for April 2027, and is presumed innocent of the murders.

episodes.title: The BTK Floppy Disk
episodes.description:
Welcome back to CrimeTimeSnacks, I'm Cory. Today we're looking at one of the most infamous cold cases in American history, the BTK killer. For decades, a phantom haunted Wichita, Kansas, binding and suffocating victims while sending taunting letters to the police and media.

But after going completely silent for thirteen years, the killer made a fatal mistake. He decided to reach out one more time, mailing items to law enforcement that would finally unravel his double life as a family man and security alarm installer. We'll trace the timeline from his chilling childhood fantasies to the digital footprint that brought him down.

episodes.title: The Doomsday Mom
episodes.description: The case of Lori Vallow Daybell and Chad Daybell began with the disappearance of two children in Rexburg, Idaho. The episode traces how a religious fiction author and a mother of three crossed paths and formed a small apocalyptic group, the suspicious deaths around them, and the flight to Hawaii. It runs from the initial police inquiries to the discovery of the crime scene, and looks at the documented evidence of how doomsday beliefs and financial motives merged.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Maura Murray
episodes.description: In 2004, nursing student Maura Murray packed up her dorm room, emailed her professors a fake excuse, and drove north into the White Mountains. She crashed her car on Route 112 and refused a passing driver's offer of help; by the time police arrived minutes later, she was gone. The episode walks through her final days, the decisions she made before leaving, and the online mystery her disappearance became.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Laci Peterson
episodes.description: Laci Peterson was twenty-seven years old and eight months pregnant with her first child when she vanished from her home in Modesto, California, on Christmas Eve in 2002. The search for Laci and her unborn son Conner brought in large numbers of volunteers and national headlines. The episode walks through Laci and Scott's early lives, their meeting in college, and the secrets beneath the surface of their life together.

episodes.title: The Zodiac Ciphers
episodes.description: Between 1968 and 1969, the Zodiac targeted couples on lonely roads and a cab driver in the San Francisco Bay Area, then taunted police and the public with letters, bomb threats, and cryptograms sent to local newspapers. The episode walks through the confirmed timeline: the attacks that left five dead and two wounded, the race to decode the ciphers, and the messages that remained unsolved for over fifty years.

episodes.title: Ted Bundy and the Murder of Kimberly Leach
episodes.description: Ted Bundy's crimes ran from his early murders in Washington and Utah, through his escape from a Colorado jail, to Florida in 1978, where twelve-year-old Kimberly Leach disappeared from her school. He used a fake arm sling and a charming demeanor to lure young women to his Volkswagen Beetle. The episode walks through the timeline, the escapes, and the stolen car in Pensacola that ended his run across the country.

episodes.title: The Touch DNA of JonBenet
episodes.description:
In 1996, six-year-old JonBenet Ramsey was found dead in the basement of her family's home in Boulder, Colorado. The initial police work was heavily criticized, and early suspicion fell on her parents. Years later, trace DNA found on her clothing pointed to an unidentified male, and in 2008 the district attorney sent the family a letter clearing them.

The episode walks through the timeline of that morning, the grand jury that voted to indict the parents, and the DNA evidence that changed the official account of the case.

episodes.title: The Trial and Appeals of Adnan Syed
episodes.description:
In 1999, high school student Hae Min Lee vanished in Baltimore County and was found dead weeks later in Leakin Park. The investigation centered on her ex-boyfriend, Adnan Syed, and the trial that followed went on to hold the country's attention.

The episode walks through the disappearance, the cell tower evidence, and the testimony that sent Syed to prison, then the appeals, the vacated conviction, and its reinstatement, which have kept the case in the courts for more than twenty years.
